title: FAI MCP Marketplace Entry v1
description: Canonical schema for one server record in the FAI MCP Marketplace catalog (persisted at `frootai/orchard/registry/mcp-marketplace-cache.json`, mirrored to the CDN + bundled snapshots). Covers every field from §2.1 of the marketplace masterplan. Crawl-time fields are required; trust + spec fields are filled by later phases ([X1] trust, [X2]/[X5] specs) and are optional until assigned.
$comment: License: CC0-1.0. Authored as part of Phase [X0.6] of the FAI MCP Marketplace + Trust masterplan (02-marketplace-and-trust-masterplan.md). Provenance doctrine §0.5 #8 — every entry records (crawled_at, source_url, owner, publisher_classification, attach_spec_version, last_drift_check, snapshot_sha).

slug.description: Server slug (the repo segment of `/mcp/<owner>/<slug>`). GitHub repo names allow mixed case, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

owner.description: Publisher/owner exactly as upstream (e.g. `microsoft`, `ChromeDevTools`, `io.shipbook`). Reverse-DNS namespaces (containing a dot) are legal. NEVER aliased (doctrine #2 — NEVER SHADOW PUBLISHER IDENTITY).

title.description: Human-readable display name from the card (falls back to slug when the card has no name).

description.description: One-line server description from the card. May be empty.

category.description: Frozen 6-bucket category ([X0.18] classifies from the description). Null until classified.

install_count.description: Install count from the card (comma-grouping normalized away). 0 when unknown — never NaN/negative.

github_url.description: Canonical GitHub repo URL ([X0.5] resolves it from the detail page). Null when not yet resolved (e.g. reverse-DNS owners).

github_org.description: Canonical GitHub org parsed from github_url ([X0.21]). May differ from `owner` (e.g. a monorepo server). Null until resolved.

github_repo.description: Canonical GitHub repo parsed from github_url ([X0.21]). May differ from `slug`. Null until resolved.

publisher_classification.description: Publisher tier from classification ([X1]). Mirrors trust_tier; recorded separately for provenance.

trust_tier.description: Trust tier assigned by the trust manifest ([X1]). Absent until assigned.

evidence_file.description: Repo-relative path to the per-publisher trust evidence file ([X1]). Null for community/untrusted with no evidence.

npm_package.description: npm package the server ships as ([X0.5]). Null for non-npm servers.

uvx_package.description: Python (uvx) package the server ships as ([X0.5]). Null for non-Python servers.

attach_spec.description: Attach invocation hint ([X0.5] inferred; [X2]/[X4] validated). Null until known.

attach_spec_version.description: SemVer of the attach spec shape for this server. Bumped when the validated spec changes (per [X2.16] version pin discipline).

tools_snapshot_sha.description: SHA-256 of the captured `tools/list` snapshot ([X2.10]). Null until a snapshot is taken.

last_synced_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent catalog sync for this entry ([X0.16]). Drives the >60-day amber flag.

last_drift_check_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent attach-drift check ([X0.17]/[X2]). Null until the first nightly validation.

last_commit_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the upstream repo's last commit ([X0.5]). Null when not resolved.

detail_source.description: Provenance of the detail-fetch enrichment ([X0.5]): live Playwright fetch vs offline derivation.

source_page.description: Registry page the card was found on (1-based).

url.description: Endpoint URL for http-sse / http-stream transports.

source.description: Whether the spec was inferred from the detail page ([X0.5]) or validated against the live upstream ([X2]).

crawled_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the crawl that produced this record.

source_url.description: The registry URL the record was crawled from (e.g. https://github.com/mcp?page=1).

source_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the raw crawled source for tamper-evidence.
